settings.title: CarPlay Ultra
settings.description: The CarPlay theme (Aston Martin DBX look), its wallpapers and Themes page, and a climate panel per seat. Needs the E-GMP CarPlay EV Routing mod with its CarPlay theme on, and after turning it on: forget the car on the iPhone (Settings > General > CarPlay) and pair again. Off: CarPlay climate only, in the classic CarPlay layout; then also turn the EV Routing mod's CarPlay theme off, or CarPlay can stay black. Restart the head unit afterwards.

settings.title: Seat ventilation in the Climate app
settings.description: Adds ventilation to the existing front seat heating/cooling controls. The four displayed cooling steps map to the EV6's three physical levels. Commands require fresh seat feedback and option 6. Restart and reconnect afterwards.

settings.title: Steering wheel heat in the Climate app
settings.description: Adds an on/off wheel-heat widget using the tested EV6 command. Some iOS theme layouts overlap AUTO; switch this off to use Vehicle > Comfort instead. Restart and reconnect afterwards.

settings.title: AirPlay video while parked (experimental)
settings.description: Enables video from supported iPhone apps. Playback requires an active CarPlay session and fresh confirmation that the gear is in P; leaving P or losing feedback stops playback. Uses the phone's CarPlay audio. FairPlay-protected content is unsupported. New on this EV6 and needs a parked test. Restart afterwards.

settings.title: Keep video picture with the phone audio
settings.description: For optional parked video, corrects picture lag after network stalls, including live streams. Restart afterwards.

settings.title: Rear window defrost from CarPlay
settings.description: CarPlay's rear window button turns the car's rear defrost on and off (READY only) and shows its state. The state comes from a listener on the car's body controller, registered only if that listener is exactly the one this was checked against (Ioniq 6 CEEV 260507); otherwise the button works without showing the state. Turn it off if the head unit misbehaves. Restart the head unit afterwards.

settings.title: The car's page in CarPlay's Vehicle app
settings.description: CarPlay's Vehicle app shows the car's battery level, range and odometer, optional Light Vibes and Launchpad controls, and shortcuts for Kia screens and HMG-API. Off: remove these custom rows from the next connection's vehicle description. Restart and reconnect afterwards.

settings.title: Car volume in CarPlay
settings.description: CarPlay's Volume page (Vehicle app) shows the head unit's real volume for media, navigation, phone and Siri, follows the volume knob and the steering wheel buttons, and sets the car's volume when changed on the phone's side; its mute switch mutes the car's sound. Off: CarPlay's volume page shows placeholder values and does nothing. Restart the head unit afterwards.

settings.title: Only CarPlay's volume slider in CarPlay (experiment)
settings.description: While CarPlay is on the screen, the volume knob and the steering wheel's volume buttons change the volume without the head unit's own volume pop-up, so only CarPlay's slider shows. Needs "Car volume in CarPlay" on. Everywhere else the volume works and looks as always. An experiment: it answers the volume keys inside the car's system software; if the volume keys ever misbehave, turn it off and restart. Restart the head unit afterwards.

settings.title: Keep adb over USB through CarPlay (for testing)
settings.description: When CarPlay connects, the head unit's USB port stops answering adb. With this on, the mod's root service switches the port to host mode and back to adb about 12 seconds after each CarPlay connect, which is what turning the ADB mod's "ADB over USB" off and on does. Only the live setting is changed. Leave it off unless a computer is plugged in for adb: while the port is switched, a phone or USB stick on it is disconnected for a moment.

settings.title: Drive log (for testing)
settings.description: While CarPlay is connected, reads more of the car's values every 5 seconds (speed, gear, range and consumption figures, window and parking brake states, tyre states) and writes them to a file on the head unit when they change, to work out what the car reports on the move. Reads only; nothing is sent to the car. The file stops growing at 4 MB. Restart the head unit afterwards.

settings.title: Log Kia touchscreen climate commands
settings.description: Diagnostic: observes the stock Kia climate and seat-command calls and logs their integer arguments. Does not change or send commands. Helps compare recirculation and seat controls with CarPlay. Turn off and restart to stop tracing.
